Hi Elena / AP team,

Attached is the final statement for Greenleaf's renewal true-up (Q2 run-rate to contract end). Key points:  
- Total due (net of prepaid credit): EUR 48,720
- Requested split: subscription EUR 42,000 + one-time true-up EUR 6,720 (so that VAT handling matches each line)

Can you confirm the PO/PR number to appear on the invoice, and whether you require us to apply the EU reverse-charge note on the subscription line? If Greenleaf will self-account for VAT, we will leave VAT blank on the subscription line and include the reverse-charge text. For the one-time true-up, we will apply the local VAT rate if required.

I've attached the statement and provisional split for your review. If it's acceptable, we'll issue a pro-forma invoice with bank details and payment schedule options (single wire within 30 days or two-part: 60% now / 40% in 30 days).

Attachments: [Attachment: Greenleaf_statement_Q2_2027.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — received and reviewed. A few clarifications below: 

- Greenleaf will use reverse-charge for the subscription (we are a VAT-registered business in Italy). Please leave VAT blank on that line and include the EU reverse-charge note and our VAT number: IT12345678901.
- For the one-time true-up (overage/one-off professional services), we need VAT applied at the Italian standard rate unless you classify it as a service supplied outside Italy — our tax team prefers it on the invoice.
- PO: GL-PO-2027-3582 (please add on invoice header)
- Preferred payment: SEPA wire to your euro account. Please provide IBAN/BIC and the beneficiary name.

Also, we will need a credit note if any unused seats are returned before the contract end date — I'll confirm quantities by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Elena Rossi

- One-time true-up: EUR 6,720 + 22% VAT (applied) = EUR 8,198.40

Bank / SEPA details attached: redwood_bank_details_SEPA.txt (IBAN/BIC + beneficiary). Please use GL-PO-2027-3582 as the payment reference. 

Payment options we can support (choose one):
- Single payment: full gross amount within 30 calendar days of invoice date

If Greenleaf confirms the credit note need for returned seats, we'll prepare a draft credit memo that can be applied against the invoice.

- Soojin: once Elena confirms, please approve final invoice and send to accounts.payable@greenleaf.io
